notes: Used only by the optional 'work.py audit' command and [AUDIT] tasks. Nothing else reads it.
A finding is 'proven' only when the language tool reports one of the 'proven' codes inside the scope. Everything else is a candidate.
A language with no tool, or whose tool is not installed, is an explicit coverage gap in the report.
A tool runs from 'cwd' (default: repository root) so a directory-local toolchain file applies; its relative paths are resolved from there.
'protected' paths (fnmatch, '*' crosses '/') are never audited: vendored and generated code.
'keep' records what the owner decided to leave: {"path": glob, "reason": text, optional "code", optional "contains"}. The audit stops reporting it.
